column.text: Bitcoin surged past the seventy-nine thousand dollar mark, adding four hundred and fifty billion dollars to market cap as institutional accumulation drives this regime. The single most important signal is sustained ETF inflows totaling six hundred and sixty million dollars today combined with massive short liquidations where three point zero five billion in shorts were wiped out versus only six hundred and fifty million for longs. This indicates a leveraged long-term buy-in rather than speculative retail frenzy, decoupling the asset from traditional macro fear as correlation nears zero. While Fears & Greed sits at seventy-two indicating extreme greed levels, on-chain metrics show open interest expansion across Bitcoin Ethereum and Solana confirming smart money entry via ETF dry powder over four consecutive days of positive flows. The dominant risk remains extreme overextension on four-hour timeframes where RSI levels are critically high suggesting an imminent mean reversion or consolidation before the next leg up. Dollar liquidity is contracting creating a macro headwind that demands more proof on continuation longs and treats failed rallies as better odds shorts unless accompanied by real catalysts like Tesla rising to one-month highs or Anthropic preparing for its massive late August filing. The Clarity Act remains a major focus for federal officials while JPMorgan warns of an autumn selloff despite this week potentially marking the best ten-day period according to Tom Lee. Mantra Chain halted activity due to security issues but whale profits remain around seventy million dollars preventing timely position additions during rapid gains.
